description: Dependency updates (CMS-SPEC §12.8): every update waits 3 days after release and is merged by a person after CI and the smoke tests; nothing is merged automatically.

schedule: before 9am on the first day of the month

description: Security fixes are proposed at once, outside the weekly window; a person reviews and merges them (critical within 48 h, high within 7 days).
Payload and every @payloadcms/* package move together, on one exact version (§1).
Next with its React pair; read the Next release notes and node_modules/next/dist/docs before merging (AGENTS.md).
Major versions one at a time, never grouped, never automatic.
Node stays on the 24 LTS line (§1); Postgres stays on 17 (a major upgrade needs a dump and restore).
Base images and pinned third-party images, grouped; the image is rebuilt monthly anyway.
GitHub Actions pinned by commit SHA.
